en.headline: A round Pingu pouch featuring Pinga
en.intro: This round pouch features Pinga and is sold on Japan's official Pingu online store. A FeelBetter concierge checked the model, stock and price, and after you order we buy it there and ship it to you.
highlights: The round shape and the Pinga design make it a cute, easy-to-spot pouch.
As a pouch, it keeps small belongings together in one place.
It is sold as official Pingu goods and bought from Japan's official Pingu online store, so you receive genuine merchandise.
It makes an easy gift for Pingu and Pinga fans.

sections.p: Use the pouch to keep small belongings tidy at home or on the go. If you are looking for another Pingu item, our concierge can help through the request page.

cautions: The listing does not give the pouch's size, material or closure type, so please check the photos or ask our concierge before ordering.

highlights: 동그란 모양과 Pinga 디자인 덕분에 눈에 잘 띄는 귀여운 파우치예요.

Pingu와 Pinga를 좋아하는 분께 선물하기 쉬운 아이템이에요.

sections.p: 집에서든 외출할 때든 자잘한 소지품을 가지런히 담아 두는 데 쓰시면 돼요. 다른 Pingu 굿즈를 찾으신다면 컨시어지 요청 페이지로 문의해 주세요.

PinguやPingaが好きな方へのギフトにも気軽に選べます。

sections.p: ご自宅でも外出先でも、細かな持ち物をすっきり収納するのにお使いください。ほかのPinguグッズをお探しの場合は、コンシェルジュのリクエストページからご相談ください。
